༄༅/ /zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra'i snying po lus dkyil rdzogs rim dang bcas pa shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra'i snying po lus dkyil rdzogs rim dang bcas pa shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra nas gsungs pa'i lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ yang zlog ngag 'don bsnyen mtshams bar byas rjes/ gtso 'khor gyi bsnyen pa ci 'grub byas la/ lus dkyil dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro'i srung 'khor ni/ nang lus mtshams kyi dgongs pa/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i ra ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur khang*/ sor mo rnams mtshon cha'i dra gur/ skra dang ba spu me ri/ snying po srog rtsol gyi rlung dbyung 'jug ni hūm̐ ring sngags sgrar gdod nas grub pa'o hūm̐ ring rlung rdor bzlas bya/ zhes mos/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo/ */dang po bskyed rim la lnga/ bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen mo/ las sbyor ro// dang po bsnyen pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa ni gnyis/ rten dang brten pa'o// dang po rten ni/ mtshan ma'i rdzas rnams gzhal yas khang ste/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang pa gnyis stobs chen rlung gi zhon pa| sum mdo gru gsum me// lto ba zlum po khrag mtsho/ sgal mkhar ri rab bang rim/ de ltar dbang chen yum lnga'i rang bzhin rkang brgyad ka ba/ rtsa brgyad bsnol ba bcu drug gdung*/ mig gnyis pañtsa re kha/ sna rin chen pha gu/ so dang rgyu long dra ba dra phyed/ lce 'dod snam/ snying 'khor lo'i lte ba zlum po/ snying gi phyogs bzhi'i rtsa bzhi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi/ phyi'i rtsa brgyad rtsibs brgyad/ byang khog khyams chen/ bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad rta babs/ pags pa smug po dur khrod/ sor mo mtshon dra/ skra dang ba spu me long*/ lus gnas rang byung gzhal yas khang*/ rig pa rang byung yi dam lha'o// gnyis pa brten pa lha ni/ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lor byang sems kā di so bzhi ni yab gshin rje'i gshed po/

mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lor shes rab ā di bcu drug sbyor yum/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor ma me dakṣe bzhi gshed chen bzhi/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha rnams mon pa bzhi dang bdud bzhi/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni rnams 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ yan lag gi mthil sgo bzhir e dun ka ye bzhi sgo ba bzhi rnams ma bskyed ye rdzogs chen por gdod nas grub pa rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi sku'o zhes so// sngags bzla ba ni/ srog rtsol phyir rgyu ba na gtor ba/ nang du rngub pa dril ba/ rang sor gnas pa bsnyen sgrub sbrags pa nyid do// zhes pas/ rlung 'byung 'jug gi tshe 'dir a kro bcu gnyis te bcu gcig pa'i ya dang mān mtshams sbyor phral bas bcu gnyis pa'o// phyir dbyung tshe so gnyis pa gtor nang du rngub tshe dang bcu gnyis pa hril gtor dril gnas pa bsnyen sgrub sbrags mar a kro bcu gnyis pa dang so gnyis pa sprel rdor bzlas bya'o// gnyis pa nye bsnyen rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa ni/ rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i khong par dhū ti sngon po/ yar sne tshangs sgo/ mar sne gsang bar slebs pa thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin snying gar hūm̐ nag po/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin snying thad āḥdamar po/ g.yas su rkyang ma dkar po sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin snying thad oṃ dkar po dang bcas pa ro rkyang gnyis 'khor lo bzhi la zang thal du gnas pa/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis dkar po gdugs rtsibs lta bu tshangs sgor haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab bcu drug dmar po bum ske dra bas btums pa lta bu'i dbus su mtshal chen gyi kha dog lta bu'i hrīḥ snying gar rtsa 'dab brgyad nag po la a su nṛ tri pre du/ lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi ser po gser gyi khri'u lta bu/

'khor lo bzhi yi spyi bo dang mgrin par thig le re re/ snying ga dang lte bar bcu gnyis/ gsang bar so gnyis/ yan lag bzhir re re rnams dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i gong bur gnas pa/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'khor lo bzhi'i thig le rnams la phog pas de rnams 'od du zhu zhing 'bar ba las/ spyi bor yab/ mgrin par yum/ snying gar gshed mon bdud bcu gnyis/ lte bar 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ gsang bar gshin rje so gnyis/ yan lag bzhir sgo ba bzhi rnams ma bskyed ye rdzogs rtsal can rnal 'byor chen por gdod nas yongs su grub pa'o/ */ zhes sam// gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ srog rtsol gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ rang lhar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i ro rkyang yas sne sna bug dang*/ mas sne lte 'og sor bzhi dbu ma'i nang du yi ge cha dbyibs ltar zug pa'i steng du yaṃ sngo skya/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dbus rakta'i dwangs ma raṃ dmar po/ phyi skor du rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya tsa ni/ snying gar dbus su ya/ phyogs bzhir ma me dakṣe/ phyi rim du a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ mgrin par dbus su hrīḥ phyi skor du ā di bcu drug /spyi bor tshangs snod dkar cha'i dwangs ma haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ rtsa 'dab la kā di so bzhi rnams gsal/ srog rtsol bum can du bsdams pas ro rkyang gi rlung bus pa yaṃ la phog /de las rlung byung*/ raṃ las me 'bar dhū ti'i nang brgyud haṃ la reg cing thim pas/ haṃ las dkar cha bab pa dmar cha'i me dang 'dres pas rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rnams gang*/ yi ge rnams nyon mongs kyi ngo bor grub pa bsregs shing ye shes kyi ngo bo slar bsos pas 'od zer 'bar zhing 'phro bas rang bzhin gsal ba/ bde stong gnyis med 'khor ba'i bag chags thams cad chos nyid du ye nas dag pa gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang du bsgom mo// bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po yongs rdzogs lus kyi mchod rten rgya mdud brtsegs pa la brten pa ni/

rang lus gdod nas mchod rten yongs rdzogs chen po rtsa chen so gnyis gzhal yas khang*/ khams thig le yig 'bru lha'i dkyil 'khor chen por ye nas rdzogs pa/ tshigs chen rus mdud so gnyis bang rim/ lto ba zlum po bum pa/ brang dang phrag so bre rmang*/ mgrin pa bcu gsum 'khor lo/ klad rgya dang thod pa char khebs/ rna ba dar dpyangs dang dril bu 'khrol ba/ tshangs bug tog stong 'bar ba/ rtsa dbu ma rang byung srog shing*/ phung po lnga yab/ 'byung ba lnga yum/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad sras dang 'khor tshogs rnams mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar ma 'gags rig rtsal dbyings su shar ba rang byung gi pho brang dkyil 'khor chen por ye nas rdzogs pa mi shigs rdzogs chen rang byung lus gnas kyi mchod rten gang gis kyang gzhig cing gzhom du med pa'o// zhes so// lnga pa las 'khrul 'khor lnga skor ba la brten pa sbyor ni/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge rnams med par gsal btab/ spyi bor bum can bsdams/ yi ge so gnyis pa zla ba 'khrul 'khor phyi'i phyi ltar bskor bas me mnyam bcings/ zhe sdang gi dgra bsad/ mgrin par bum can bsdams/ bcu bdun pa'i mgor ayai btags te bco brgyad pa zla ba nang gi phyi ltar bskor bas srog 'dzin bcings/ 'dod chags kyi dgra bsad| snying gar bum can bsdams/ yi ge bcu bdun 'phye bo 'gros ya bor/ stag mo'i mchong la thog mthar oṃ dang phaṭa sbyar bzla/ gsang ba'i phyi ltar bskor bas thur sel bcings/ gti mug gi dgra bsad/ lte bar bum can bsdams/ yi ge bcu bdun ldog ste bzlas pa nang gi nang ltar bskor bas gyen du bcings/ nga rgyal gyi dgra bsad/ gsang bar bum can bsdams/ dam tshig bcu pa dang bcu bdun pa sbrel nas bzla ba kun gyi gsang ba ltar bskor bas khyab byed bcings/ phrag dog gi dgra bsad do// gnyis pa rdzogs sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug gsum la brten pa rim ni/

rlung bum can bzung bas/ snod bcud bdag gzhan rdzas su 'dzin par zhen pa'i gnyis snang thams cad dang bral ba/ gzugs snang gdod nas sangs rgyas gzugs med mthong ba'i ngo bo gsal dag gzugs skur zhen pa'i mtha' las 'das pa sgyu lus/ sangs rgyas sems can dbyer med rang sems rnam dag khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed du rang grol ba 'od gsal bde chen stong nyid dbyer med pa 'od gsal rang sems lha sku sgyu ma lta bu snang phyogs/ de nyid gzung 'dzin dang bral ba 'od gsal stong phyogs/ snang stong dbyer med don dam kun rdzob spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa nyi ma dang 'od ltar dbyer med pa ni zung 'jug go// gsum pa rjes bza' ba bdud rtsi'i bcud nam mkha' zas su za zhing gos su gyon pa len ni/ mthar srog rtsol gyi rlung bsdams pas/ phyi'i nam mkha' bai ḍūrya zhu ba'i khu ba ltar sngo nar gyis drangs kha sna'i lam brgyud nang gi nam mkha' dang 'dres/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ba spu'i khung bu'i mthar thug par khyab/ phyi'i nam mkha' sngo lhabs kyis lus la'ang gyon/ phyi nang gi nam mkha' dang phyi nang gi rlung bsres/ rtog med du bzhag pas logs nas ma btsal| rang la lhun grub/ bde stong*/ spros bral/ rang gshis/ rang babs ngang gi gnas lugs ma bcos pa rtog med du mnyam par bzhag /des ni rang sar rang grol ba'o/ */ sde rjes su bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo// brgyad byung tshul ltar rang las gzhan du med pa'i yin lugs kyang bsgom na rgyud 'di nyid kyi le'u nga gsum pa ltar bla ma'i zhal gdams kyis brgyan te bsgom pa yin no// 'di'i rtsa ba'i rlung lnga po lus gnas lngar gnas tshul gzhan dang cung zad mi 'dra yang rgyud 'di nyid rang gi lugs su zad do// de ltar lus dkyil rdzogs rim dang bcas pa 'di ni/ zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra'i le'u gnyis pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa/ bcu pa/ bcu gcig pa/

zhe gcig pa/ re bzhi pa/ don bzhi pa rnams su gsungs pa rnams sa bcad tho tsam du bris pa yin gyi/ sgom tshul zhib cha ni rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog du dgyes par byas pa'i gsung gi gsang ba kho na las rtogs par bya dgos pa yod do// zhes pa ni 'bri gung skyu ra'i rigs kyi sngags pa chos kyi grags pas/ rang bzo dang chos lugs gzhan gyi bsre lhad spu tsam med par rgyud kyi dgongs pa kho na tshig lhug par bsdebs te/ shing spre'u tha skar zla ba'i dmar po'i rgyal ba gnyis par/ dbur stod rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa dbang ma thob pa la bstan na las kyi gshin rje dang bang so dmar po'i gter srung gi bka' chad drag po thog ltar phob cig/ //sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
